lines.label: B1
lines.reason: Base plate (outer skin 2) to long flange (outer skin 3), about 91 deg. In my perpendicular sections at 25/50/75% the label sits on the outer-skin apex of the fold arc. The outer surface is at ab -0.04/-0.02/0.00 mm, the outermost point is 0.15-0.31 mm lateral, and the inner skin is about 1.4 mm away, which confirms the label is on the convex side. The face-on close-up shows the line running the full fold between the two corner relief notches (t 0 to 150 mm). Near-line support runs from t 0.5 to 149.7 with no gaps. Parallel to the fold.

lines.label: B2
lines.reason: Flange to left end tab (about 48 deg, outer skins 4 and 6). In the 25/50/75% sections the label sits on the outer apex (ab -0.02/-0.02/-0.01 mm). The face-on close-up shows the line spanning the full 17.5 mm tab width, edge to edge, and the support is continuous. Well above the 10 deg threshold.

lines.label: B3
lines.reason: Flange to right end tab (about 49 deg, outer skins 4 and 7). In the 25/50/75% sections the label sits on the outer apex (ab -0.03/-0.03/+0.01 mm). The face-on close-up shows the line spanning the full 17.5 mm tab width, and the support is continuous. A real formed fold.
